notes.title: New Discord Server!
notes.notes:
Hey y'all!

I've got some thrilling news to share with you today – I've just launched a brand new Discord server, and I can't wait for you to join the community!

[url=https://discord.gg/A646xD2aW5]Discord Link[/url]

Over the past few months, I've made incredible progress on this game, and I'm super excited to showcase it. I'll also be hosting an exclusive private playtesting demo, sometime in February, but not before releasing an updated trailer around the same time.

This is a golden opportunity to dive in, share your thoughts, and actively contribute to the development process. Your feedback is immensely valuable and will play a crucial role in making our project even more extraordinary.

See you all soon!
